regions.merged_text: My Dear Willie: - Many thanks for favor just read. you are well and doing. Thank God for everything. I am glad to know I wish you would convey best wishes and blessings to all my friends you chance to meet in picturesque, beautiful Yonkers. This has been the busiest place I been located in so far . . · Near 31 years now since I went to Yonkers - and Willie was one of Fr. Stephan's boys.
